correctness.rationale: For rank-at-most-one square-zero A,B, commutation forces AB=BA=0 by image-line containment. Thus the common image S lies in common kernel K, with dim S and codim K at most r. Every tuple belongs to precisely a finite union of intermediate d-plane incidence loci; these are closed irreducible images of rank-one determinantal bundles over Grassmannians. Generic spans give uniqueness of U and component noncontainment; dimensions are d(n-d)+r(n-1). Over F_q, rank-one map counts and subspace-lattice Möbius inversion give the exact all-r Gaussian formula; thirteen independent finite-field exhaustive tests (including F_4 and n=4) replayed successfully. This is a general proof, not inference from finite checks.

value.rationale: Minimal nilpotent orbit closures are canonical natural strata within the established nilpotent commuting variety problem. The theorem gives a sharp irreducibility boundary at n=2r, all irreducible components and their individual dimensions (including non-equidimensional examples), plus exact labelled finite-field counts for every arity. These are natural structural and arithmetic invariants across an infinite family rather than an arbitrary small census.
